focus: Track partner financing, capacity delivery and recognized revenue separately from planned capacity.
focusZh: 分別追蹤夥伴融資、容量交付與已認列收入，避免與規劃容量混淆。
risks: Partner financing and operating standards remain execution requirements; planned capacity is not completed capacity.
risksZh: 夥伴融資與營運標準仍是執行條件；規劃容量不等於已完成容量。

sources.title: Nebius introduces business model to scale AI cloud globally through infrastructure partnerships
sources.titleZh: Nebius 推出透過基礎設施夥伴擴展 AI 雲端的模式
sources.evidenceText: partners finance and own the infrastructure and hardware
sources.summary: Nebius described a partner-owned infrastructure model in which it supplies its AI cloud platform and brings capacity to customers.
sources.summaryZh: Nebius 公布夥伴持有基礎設施的模式，由 Nebius 提供 AI 雲端平台並向客戶供應容量。

focus: Compare backlog conversion, active capacity and financing costs against recognized revenue.
focusZh: 比較待履約合約轉為收入、已啟用容量及融資成本。
risks: Backlog depends on delivery and service availability; contracted power differs from active power.
risksZh: 待履約合約取決於交付及服務可用性；已簽約電力與已啟用電力不同。

sources.title: CoreWeave Reports Strong Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: CoreWeave 公布 2026 年第二季業績
sources.evidenceText: Expanded active power by nearly 500 MWs to reach 1.5 GW
sources.summary: CoreWeave reported Q2 revenue and backlog alongside increased active and contracted power, with continued reported losses.
sources.summaryZh: CoreWeave 公布第二季收入及待履約合約，並增加已啟用與已簽約電力容量；申報結果仍有虧損。

focus: Track cloud revenue, capital investment funding and remaining performance obligations separately.
focusZh: 分別追蹤雲端收入、資本投入融資及剩餘履約義務。
risks: Contracted demand and management expectations are distinct from recognized revenue and operating cash flow.
risksZh: 合約需求與管理層預期不同於已認列收入及營運現金流。

sources.title: Oracle Announces Record Q4 and FY 2026 Results Driven by Cloud Infrastructure & Cloud Applications
sources.titleZh: Oracle 公布 2026 財年第四季及全年業績
sources.evidenceText: Free cash flow was negative
sources.summary: Oracle reported cloud infrastructure growth alongside capital investment and negative fiscal-year free cash flow.
sources.summaryZh: Oracle 公布雲端基礎設施成長，同時說明資本投入及全年負自由現金流。

focus: Separate AI semiconductor sales from other segments and distinguish reported results from quarterly guidance.
focusZh: 區分 AI 半導體收入與其他部門，並分開檢視實績及季度指引。
risks: Guidance is an estimate; non-GAAP measures require reconciliation with GAAP results.
risksZh: 指引屬估計；非 GAAP 指標須與 GAAP 實績調節比較。

sources.title: Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend
sources.titleZh: Broadcom 公布 2026 財年第三季業績及季度股息
sources.evidenceText: Demand for our custom AI accelerators and networking continues to be very strong
sources.summary: Broadcom reported AI semiconductor demand and results within its broader semiconductor and infrastructure software businesses.
sources.summaryZh: Broadcom 公布 AI 半導體需求與業績，其業務同時涵蓋其他半導體及基礎設施軟體。

focus: Monitor campus delivery and financing, distinguishing base-term commitments from optional renewals and utility power from critical IT load.
focusZh: 追蹤園區交付及融資，區分基本租期與選擇性續租，以及公用電力容量與關鍵 IT 負載。
risks: Contracted revenue is spread across future lease years; the larger renewal-inclusive value depends on options being exercised. Construction and customer acceptance remain execution milestones.
risksZh: 合約收入分布於未來租期；包含續租的較大金額須以選擇權實際行使為前提。建設與客戶驗收仍是執行重點。

sources.title: Applied Digital Signs 210 MW Lease at Delta Forge 2, Expanding Its AI Factory Franchise Model to a Fifth Campus
sources.titleZh: Applied Digital · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: The agreement covers 210 MW of critical IT load under a 15-year take-or-pay structure
sources.summary: Applied Digital announced a 210 MW critical IT lease at Delta Forge 2 with an investment-grade U.S. hyperscaler. The 15-year base term represents approximately $5.2 billion of contracted revenue.
sources.summaryZh: Applied Digital 宣布 Delta Forge 2 與美國投資等級大型雲端業者簽訂 210 MW 關鍵 IT 負載租約，15 年基本租期約有 52 億美元合約收入。

focus: Track commissioning, testing and customer acceptance against contracted capacity; compare recognized AI revenue with operating ARR and GPU financing costs.
focusZh: 追蹤已簽約容量的啟用、測試及客戶驗收，並比較已認列 AI 收入、營運 ARR 與 GPU 融資成本。
risks: ARR is a non-GAAP operating metric and recognized revenue may be materially lower. Mining conversions caused impairments; some customer deployments use 9% fixed-rate financing.
risksZh: ARR 是非 GAAP 營運指標，實際認列收入可能明顯較低。挖礦設施轉型產生減損，部分客戶部署採用 9% 固定利率融資。

sources.title: IREN Reports FY26 Results
sources.titleZh: IREN · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: AI Cloud Services revenue increased ~8x to $128.8m in FY26
sources.summary: IREN reported FY26 AI cloud revenue of $128.8 million and $4 billion of contracted ARR for 2026 capacity versus $1 billion operating ARR. It delivered its first Horizon deployment to Microsoft in August.
sources.summaryZh: IREN 公布 FY26 AI 雲端收入 1.288 億美元，2026 容量已簽約 ARR 為 40 億美元，相較已營運 ARR 約 10 億美元；8 月向 Microsoft 交付首個 Horizon 部署。

focus: Monitor remaining Black Pearl halls, Barber Lake completion and Stingray construction; separate early-stage site options from operating rent-producing capacity.
focusZh: 追蹤 Black Pearl 剩餘機房、Barber Lake 完工及 Stingray 建設，區分早期場址選擇權與已營運收租容量。
risks: Apollo is an option and studied load submission, not an energized facility. Q2 adjusted EBITDA remained negative and project expansion increased borrowing obligations.
risksZh: Apollo 仍是場址選擇權與研究負載申請，並非已通電設施。第二季調整後 EBITDA 仍為負值，專案擴建增加借款負擔。

sources.title: Cipher Digital Provides Second Quarter 2026 Business Update
sources.titleZh: Cipher Digital · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: rent has commenced at the site
sources.summary: Cipher Digital reported initial Black Pearl delivery and rent commencement two months ahead of the original schedule. It also secured an option for the up-to-900 MW Apollo site and completed Stingray project financing.
sources.summaryZh: Cipher Digital 表示 Black Pearl 首批容量已於 8 月交付並開始收租，比原定時程提前兩個月；另取得最高 900 MW Apollo 場址選擇權並完成 Stingray 專案融資。

focus: Compare leased versus billing MW, colocation revenue ramp and construction spending while tracking AMD deployments and remaining mining-facility conversions.
focusZh: 比較已出租與計費 MW、託管收入成長及建設支出，並追蹤 AMD 部署與剩餘挖礦設施轉型。
risks: Potential contracted revenue is not current revenue. Construction financing, sufficient electricity and long-lead equipment remain dependencies; mining operations still contribute some revenue.
risksZh: 潛在合約收入並非當期收入。建設融資、足夠電力及長交期設備仍是必要條件，挖礦業務也仍貢獻部分收入。

sources.title: Core Scientific Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: Core Scientific · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Increased total leased customer power capacity to approximately 1.1 GW
sources.summary: Core Scientific reported approximately 1.1 GW of leased customer power and 437 MW billing by mid-July. Its AMD partnership includes 15-year agreements for approximately 530 MW across five sites.
sources.summaryZh: Core Scientific 公布約 1.1 GW 已租客戶電力容量，7 月中旬已有 437 MW 開始計費；AMD 合作包含五個場址約 530 MW 的 15 年協議。

focus: Track committed area becoming utilized area, utility costs and funding for construction; use RMB reporting and separate DayOne investment gains from operating performance.
focusZh: 追蹤已簽約面積轉為實際使用面積、電力成本及建設資金；以人民幣報表為基礎，區分 DayOne 投資收益與營運表現。
risks: Higher utility costs reduced margins. Net income included a DayOne dilution gain; USD figures are convenience translations. China regulation and investee outcomes remain material qualifiers.
risksZh: 較高電力成本壓低利潤率；淨利包含 DayOne 股權稀釋收益，美元金額僅為便利換算。中國監管及被投資公司結果仍是重要變數。

sources.title: GDS Holdings Limited Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: GDS Holdings · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Utilization rate (area utilized divided by area in service) was 79.2%
sources.summary: GDS reported Q2 revenue of RMB3.088 billion and 79.2% utilization. It raised 2026 revenue guidance to RMB12.7–13.0 billion and capex guidance to approximately RMB10 billion as data-center development increases.
sources.summaryZh: GDS 公布第二季收入人民幣 30.88 億元、使用率 79.2%，並將 2026 收入指引提高至人民幣 127 至 130 億元，資本支出約 100 億元，以擴大資料中心建設。

focus: Monitor delivered MW becoming customer utilization, wholesale revenue growth, depreciation and financing needs; retain RMB units and distinguish ADS from ordinary-share results.
focusZh: 追蹤交付 MW 轉為客戶實際使用、批發收入成長、折舊及融資需求；保留人民幣單位並區分 ADS 與普通股結果。
risks: Expansion raised depreciation and reduced GAAP gross margin; the company still reported a net loss. Each ADS represents six ordinary shares; USD amounts are translated reporting figures.
risksZh: 擴建增加折舊並降低 GAAP 毛利率，公司仍呈現淨虧損。每份 ADS 代表六股普通股，美元金額是報表換算值。

sources.title: VNET Reports Unaudited Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
sources.titleZh: VNET Group · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Wholesale capacity in service increased by 49.4% year-over-year to 1,007MW
sources.summary: VNET reported 1,007 MW of wholesale capacity in service and 744 MW utilized at June 30. Wholesale revenue grew 29.3% to RMB1.10 billion, and the company reported a 345 MW new cloud-provider order.
sources.summaryZh: VNET 公布 6 月底批發業務已投運容量 1,007 MW、已使用容量 744 MW；批發收入年增 29.3% 至人民幣 11 億元，另取得雲端業者 345 MW 新訂單。

focus: Track recurring revenue and interconnection growth alongside capacity delivery and capital spending; compare AFFO consistently after identifying one-time xScale fees.
focusZh: 追蹤經常性收入與互連成長，以及容量交付與資本支出；辨識一次性 xScale 費用後一致比較 AFFO。
risks: Quarterly revenue and AFFO included one-time xScale fees. AFFO is non-GAAP; higher construction spending and currency assumptions qualify management's outlook.
risksZh: 當季收入及 AFFO 包含一次性 xScale 費用。AFFO 為非 GAAP 指標，較高建設支出及匯率假設影響管理層展望。

sources.title: Equinix Reports Second-Quarter Results, Raises 2026 Guidance and Long-Term Outlook
sources.titleZh: Equinix · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Added a record 9,700 net interconnections in the quarter
sources.summary: Equinix reported 11% monthly recurring revenue growth and 9,700 net interconnection additions in Q2. Capacity expansion included 52 projects in 33 markets, while 2026 capital expenditure guidance reached $5–6 billion.
sources.summaryZh: Equinix 公布第二季月經常性收入成長 11%、淨增加 9,700 個互連連線；33 個市場共有 52 個擴建專案，2026 資本支出指引達 50 至 60 億美元。

focus: Track backlog conversion to rent and development funding; compare own-share bookings and core FFO excluding promote income, including small-capacity interconnection demand.
focusZh: 追蹤待交付合約轉為租金及開發資金；比較公司應佔訂約與排除績效分成收益的核心 FFO，也關注小容量互連需求。
risks: Backlog is future annualized rent, not recognized revenue. Q2 Core FFO included development promote and insurance recovery; full-share and own-share values are not interchangeable.
risksZh: 待交付合約是未來年化租金，並非已認列收入。第二季核心 FFO 包含開發績效分成與保險回收，全部持股與公司應佔數值不可混用。

sources.title: Digital Realty Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: Digital Realty · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Reported a record total backlog of $1.9 billion of annualized GAAP base rent
sources.summary: Digital Realty reported $1.9 billion of annualized base-rent backlog at full ownership share, or $1.4 billion at its own share. Q2 bookings included a $108 million contribution from small-capacity and interconnection customers.
sources.summaryZh: Digital Realty 公布按全部持股計算的年化基本租金待交付合約 19 億美元，公司應佔為 14 億美元；第二季小容量與互連客戶訂約貢獻 1.08 億美元。

focus: Track leasing conversion into operating capacity and revenue alongside capital funding and power costs.
focusZh: 追蹤簽租轉為營運容量與收入的進度，以及資本支出融資和電力成本。
risks: Records storage, digital and asset lifecycle services remain material businesses; the release identifies capital funding and data-center power costs as risks.
risksZh: 文件儲存、數位與資產生命週期服務仍是重要業務；公告列出資本支出融資和資料中心電費風險。

sources.title: Iron Mountain Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: Iron Mountain · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: Data center leasing of 110 megawatts year to date
sources.summary: Iron Mountain reported 110 MW of data-center leasing through July, including 13 MW in Q2 and 75 MW in July.
sources.summaryZh: Iron Mountain 公布截至七月累計資料中心簽租 110 MW，其中第二季 13 MW、七月 75 MW。

focus: Monitor manufacturing ramp and delivery of modular power and data-center fit-out equipment.
focusZh: 追蹤產能爬坡，以及模組電力與資料中心建置設備的交付進度。
risks: The announced regional capacity increase depends on facilities reaching full ramp; supply expansion is distinct from operating data-center ownership.
risksZh: 公告中的區域產能提升取決於工廠完成爬坡；供應設備擴產與直接持有營運資料中心不同。

sources.title: Vertiv Announces Expansion of Manufacturing Capacity Spanning Infrastructure Solutions, Power, and Rack Systems, to Meet Rising Demand
sources.titleZh: Vertiv · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: four new or expanding manufacturing facilities in the Americas
sources.summary: Vertiv announced four manufacturing additions or expansions for power, integrated cabinets and infrastructure solutions serving high-density data centers.
sources.summaryZh: Vertiv 宣布四處工廠新設或擴產，涵蓋高密度資料中心所需的電力、整合機櫃與基礎設施方案。

focus: Monitor the 2027 production start and execution of switchgear capacity expansion.
focusZh: 追蹤 2027 年投產時程與開關設備產能擴充的執行進度。
risks: The plant serves utility and industrial demand as well as data centers; announced production timing remains prospective.
risksZh: 工廠除資料中心外也服務公用事業與工業需求；公告投產日期仍屬預期。

sources.title: Eaton expands operations in Nebraska with new manufacturing facility to meet increasing switchgear demand driven by AI data center boom
sources.titleZh: Eaton · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: New 370,000-sq-ft facility in greater Omaha area expected to begin production in 2027
sources.summary: Eaton announced over $30 million of investment in Nebraska switchgear production, with the new facility expected to start production in first-half 2027.
sources.summaryZh: Eaton 宣布投入逾 3,000 萬美元擴充內布拉斯加州開關設備生產，新廠預計 2027 年上半年開始生產。

focus: Track product availability and adoption across scale-up and scale-out AI networking.
focusZh: 追蹤產品供貨與 AI scale-up、scale-out 網路的採用情況。
risks: This is a product launch with prospective availability dates, not evidence of commissioned data-center capacity or booked revenue.
risksZh: 這是附預期供貨時程的產品發布，不能視為資料中心容量已啟用或收入已入帳。

sources.title: Arista Introduces Next-Generation 1.6Terabit Portfolio for AI Fabrics
sources.titleZh: Arista Networks · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: a new portfolio of 1.6T networking platforms
sources.summary: Arista introduced 7060XE7 networking for rack-scale AI fabrics, with air-cooled 1.6T availability planned for Q4 2026 and other models for Q1 2027.
sources.summaryZh: Arista 推出用於機架級 AI 網路的 7060XE7 系列；氣冷 1.6T 型號預計 2026 年第四季供貨，其他型號預計 2027 年第一季。

focus: Monitor acquired business integration, infrastructure backlog conversion and electrical construction delivery.
focusZh: 追蹤收購業務整合、基礎設施在手訂單轉化與電氣施工交付。
risks: The company explicitly pursues diverse end markets; these acquisitions did not materially contribute in Q2, with Enerfab acquired in July.
risksZh: 公司明確布局多元終端市場；相關收購在第二季沒有重大貢獻，Enerfab 於七月收購。

sources.title: QUANTA SERVICES REPORTS SECOND QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
sources.titleZh: Quanta Services · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: in the growing data center and mission-critical facility markets
sources.summary: Quanta reported acquisitions of Phalcon and Enerfab that expand electrical, fabrication and mechanical capabilities serving data-center and other infrastructure customers.
sources.summaryZh: Quanta 公布收購 Phalcon 與 Enerfab，擴充服務資料中心及其他基礎設施客戶的電氣、製造與機械工程能力。

focus: Track factory expansion and lead-time improvements for grid equipment supporting new electricity demand.
focusZh: 追蹤工廠擴產與支援新增電力需求的電網設備交期改善。
risks: The announcement concerns grid equipment supply rather than a named data-center power contract; hiring and expansion milestones are prospective.
risksZh: 公告涉及電網設備供應，並非特定資料中心供電合約；招募及擴產里程碑仍屬預期。

sources.title: GE Vernova expands Pennsylvania manufacturing facility to strengthen U.S. grid supply chain
sources.titleZh: GE Vernova · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: including data centers, to the grid more quickly and reliably
sources.summary: GE Vernova expanded its Charleroi factory as part of a $138 million investment to improve production of high-voltage breakers, switchgear and instrument transformers.
sources.summaryZh: GE Vernova 以 1.38 億美元投資計畫擴充 Charleroi 工廠，提高高壓斷路器、開關設備與儀用變壓器的生產能力。

focus: Monitor Crane restart execution, regulatory milestones and long-term power agreement commencement.
focusZh: 追蹤 Crane 重啟執行、監管里程碑與長期供電協議開始履約的進度。
risks: Crane remains a restart project; the release reports unfavorable nuclear outages and ongoing Calpine integration across the broader generation portfolio.
risksZh: Crane 仍是重啟中的計畫；公告亦反映核電停機影響，以及整體發電組合持續整合 Calpine。

sources.title: Constellation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
sources.titleZh: Constellation Energy · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: NRC approves Crane Clean Energy Center's fuel license
sources.summary: Constellation reported FERC approval for capacity interconnection rights transfer and NRC fuel-license approval at Crane, advancing an expected 2027 restart.
sources.summaryZh: Constellation 公布 Crane 容量互連權利移轉獲 FERC 核准、燃料執照獲 NRC 核准，推進預期 2027 年重啟。

focus: Track contracted capacity deployment and additional orders under the master agreement.
focusZh: 追蹤已簽約容量部署，以及主協議下新增訂單。
risks: The 2.8 GW ceiling exceeds the initially contracted 1.2 GW; phased deployment and additional procurement remain distinct from completed capacity.
risksZh: 2.8 GW 是協議上限，高於初始已簽約 1.2 GW；分期部署與後續採購不能等同已完成容量。

sources.title: Bloom Energy and Oracle Expand Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 2.8 GW to Accelerate AI Infrastructure Build-Out
sources.titleZh: Bloom Energy · 官方業務進展
sources.evidenceText: an initial 1.2 GW of capacity has been contracted
sources.summary: Bloom announced an Oracle master agreement for up to 2.8 GW of fuel cells, with 1.2 GW contracted and deployment continuing into 2027.
sources.summaryZh: Bloom 公布 Oracle 燃料電池主協議，最高容量 2.8 GW，其中 1.2 GW 已簽約，部署持續至 2027 年。
